name: degR_at_0_degF
description: Bias value of deg Rankine at 0 deg Farenheit; needed to calculate speed of sound from temperature

name: GeometricAltitude
description: Convert input altitude, in feet, to meters, for function independent value

name: AmbientPressureRatioToSeaLevel
description: Output from table, but only used locally to calculate ambient pressure output

name: RatioOfDensityToSeaLevel
description: Direct output from table without conversion

name: SpeedOfSound
description: Calculated from ambient temperature using equation 3.6 from REF02 C equivalent: *v_sound_fps = 49.02*pow(t_amb_F + DEGR_AT_0_DEGF,0.5);

name: AmbientTemperature
description: Convert table output, in deg C, to deg F

name: AmbientPressure
description: Converts the ambient pressure ratio found in the tables (p_p0) to English units by multiplying by standard ambient sea level pressure (SEA_LEVEL_PRESSURE_psf)
